title: Digital Marketing
desc: Boost your visibility and engagement with data-driven strategies across every channel.

seo.title: Digital Marketing Services | SEO, PPC & Social – Eire Tech
seo.description: Grow traffic, leads and sales with Eire Tech's digital marketing services: SEO, social media marketing, Google and Meta ads, and content that converts.

intro:
Digital marketing works best when every channel pulls in the same direction. Eire Tech plans, runs and measures your search, social, paid and content activity as one connected programme, so each pound or dollar you spend builds on the last instead of competing with it.

We start with your goals, your customers and your numbers, not a pre-packaged bundle. From there we build a data-driven marketing strategy, launch the channels that fit, and report on the results that matter to your business: qualified leads, sales and return on ad spend.
details: Our SEO services make your website easier to find for the people already searching for what you sell. We run technical SEO audits, fix crawl and speed issues, research the keywords your customers actually use, optimise on-page content and meta data, and build local SEO and authority signals over time. The result is steady, compounding organic traffic that keeps working long after a campaign ends.

We manage social media marketing across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok and X with a clear content calendar, consistent brand voice and active community management. Every post has a purpose, whether that is building awareness, starting conversations or driving traffic, and we track engagement and conversions so your social channels contribute to real business growth.

Our pay-per-click management covers Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and more. We handle audience research, campaign structure, ad copy and creative, landing page recommendations and conversion tracking, then optimise bids and budgets every week. You get transparent reporting on cost per lead and return on ad spend, not vanity metrics.

Great content earns attention, trust and search rankings. We build a content strategy around your audience's questions and your keyword opportunities, then create blog articles, landing pages, email newsletters, guides and social content that educate your buyers and move them towards a decision.
benefits: One strategy across SEO, social, paid media and content, managed by one team
Clear monthly reporting focused on leads, sales and return on investment
Campaigns built on keyword, audience and competitor research, not guesswork
Continuous testing and optimisation to lower cost per acquisition
Flexible engagement for start-ups, SMEs and established brands
faqs: How long does SEO take to show results? | Most businesses see early movement within two to three months, with stronger, compounding results from six months onwards. Timing depends on your competition, website health and how much content you already have.

Which digital marketing channels are right for my business? | It depends on where your customers spend their time and how they buy. We audit your market and goals first, then recommend a mix of SEO, social, paid ads and content that gives you the best return for your budget.

Do you manage Google Ads and Meta Ads budgets? | Yes. We set up, manage and optimise campaigns on Google, Meta, LinkedIn and other platforms. Your ad spend is paid directly to the platform, and our management fee is kept separate and transparent.

How do you measure digital marketing performance? | We set up conversion tracking and analytics from day one, then report on the metrics tied to revenue: qualified leads, sales, cost per acquisition and return on ad spend.

title: Marketing & Business Automation
desc: Save time and increase efficiency by automating the workflows that slow your team down.

seo.title: Marketing & Business Automation Services | Eire Tech
seo.description: Automate your CRM, email and SMS campaigns, lead nurturing and business workflows with Eire Tech. Save hours every week and never lose a lead again.

intro:
Manual follow-ups, copy-and-paste data entry and disconnected tools quietly drain your team's time and let good leads slip away. Eire Tech designs and builds marketing and business automation that connects your systems and handles the repetitive work for you.

We map how leads, customers and information move through your business today, find the bottlenecks, and replace them with reliable automated workflows. Your team spends less time on admin and more time on the work that actually grows revenue.
details: We set up, migrate and integrate CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, GoHighLevel and Pipedrive. That includes pipeline design, custom fields, lead scoring, user permissions and integrations with your website forms, ad platforms, phone system and accounting software, so every customer interaction lands in one place.

Automated email marketing and SMS campaigns reach the right person at the right moment without anyone pressing send. We build welcome sequences, abandoned-cart and re-engagement flows, appointment reminders and post-purchase follow-ups, all personalised with your CRM data and measured against opens, clicks and conversions.

Business process automation removes the repetitive tasks that slow your team down. Using tools like Zapier, Make, n8n and custom integrations, we automate data entry, reporting, invoicing, onboarding, internal notifications and approvals, so work moves forward accurately and instantly.

Most leads are not ready to buy on day one. We build lead nurturing systems that score, segment and follow up with every prospect automatically, delivering helpful content over time and alerting your sales team the moment a lead shows buying intent.
benefits: Hours saved every week by removing manual, repetitive tasks
Faster lead response times and fewer missed opportunities
One accurate view of every customer across your tools
Scalable workflows that grow with your business
Documentation and training so your team stays in control
faqs: Which CRM should my business use? | The right CRM depends on your team size, sales process and budget. We compare options such as HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce and GoHighLevel against your requirements and recommend the best fit before we build anything.

Can you automate our existing tools without replacing them? | Usually, yes. We connect the software you already use through native integrations, APIs and platforms like Zapier, Make and n8n, and only suggest new tools when they clearly save time or money.

Is automated email and SMS marketing compliant? | We build campaigns with consent capture, unsubscribe handling and data protection requirements such as GDPR in mind, so your automation stays compliant as it scales.

How long does a marketing automation project take? | A focused project, such as a CRM setup or a lead nurturing sequence, typically takes two to six weeks. Larger multi-system automation is delivered in phases so you see value early.

title: Brand Management
desc: Build a consistent, powerful identity across every platform your audience sees you on.

seo.title: Brand Management Services | Strategy & Identity – Eire Tech
seo.description: Build a brand people recognise and trust. Eire Tech delivers brand strategy, positioning, guidelines, tone of voice and online reputation management.

intro:
Your brand is what people say about you when you are not in the room. Strong brand management makes sure that story is clear, consistent and working in your favour, on every website, social profile, advert and customer conversation.

Eire Tech helps start-ups define who they are and helps established businesses sharpen and protect the brand they have built. We combine strategy, creative direction and ongoing management so your identity stays recognisable and trusted as you grow.
details: We define where your brand stands in the market and why customers should choose you. Through audience research, competitor analysis and workshops, we shape your brand purpose, value proposition, positioning statement and key messages, giving every future marketing decision a clear foundation.

Brand guidelines turn your identity into a practical toolkit. We document logo usage, colour palettes, typography, imagery style and layout rules, alongside a tone of voice guide with real writing examples, so your team, agencies and freelancers all produce work that looks and sounds unmistakably like you.

Customers meet your brand on your website, social media, emails, adverts, packaging and in person. We audit every touchpoint, fix inconsistencies and manage your brand presence across platforms, so the experience feels joined up wherever someone discovers you.

Online reputation management protects the trust you have earned. We monitor reviews, social mentions and search results, respond professionally to feedback, encourage reviews from happy customers and put plans in place to handle negative comments quickly and calmly.
benefits: A clear positioning that sets you apart from competitors
Practical brand guidelines your whole team can follow
A consistent experience across every channel and touchpoint
Proactive review and reputation monitoring
Strategy and design delivered by one connected team
faqs: What is included in brand management? | Brand management covers your strategy and positioning, visual identity, tone of voice, brand guidelines and the ongoing work of keeping every channel consistent and your reputation protected.

Do I need a rebrand or just a brand refresh? | If your business, audience or offer has fundamentally changed, a rebrand may be right. If your foundations are sound but look dated or inconsistent, a refresh is usually faster and more cost-effective. We help you decide after a brand audit.

How do you handle negative reviews? | We respond quickly, professionally and constructively, move complex issues to a private conversation, and help you gather more reviews from satisfied customers so your overall rating reflects your real service.

Can you work with our existing logo and design? | Absolutely. Many clients keep their logo and we build the strategy, guidelines and consistency around it, only recommending changes where they would clearly strengthen the brand.

title: ATL & TTL Campaigns
desc: Strategic above-the-line and through-the-line advertising for maximum market reach.

seo.title: ATL & TTL Advertising Campaigns – Eire Tech
seo.description: Reach mass audiences with Eire Tech's ATL and TTL advertising: TV, radio, print, outdoor billboards and integrated campaigns planned and measured end to end.

intro:
Above-the-line (ATL) advertising builds broad awareness through mass media, while through-the-line (TTL) campaigns combine that reach with targeted digital activity that drives action. Used together, they put your brand in front of large audiences and turn attention into measurable results.

Eire Tech plans, creates and manages ATL and TTL campaigns from the first idea to the final report. We align every channel behind one creative concept and one set of goals, so your traditional and digital advertising reinforce each other.
details: We develop traditional media campaigns across television, radio and cinema that build large-scale brand awareness. Our team handles the creative concept, scripting, production coordination and media buying, choosing stations, slots and schedules that reach your target audience efficiently.

Outdoor advertising and print advertising keep your brand visible in the real world. We design and place billboards, transit and street furniture ads, digital out-of-home screens, newspaper and magazine adverts, flyers and brochures, making sure every format is bold, legible and on-brand.

Integrated multi-channel campaigns connect offline and online media under one message. A radio or billboard campaign can drive people to search, social and a dedicated landing page, where digital ads, retargeting and email capture and convert that interest.

Strong campaigns come from careful campaign planning. We define objectives and audiences, build the media plan and budget, manage suppliers and timelines, oversee execution and track results with clear KPIs such as reach, frequency, brand lift, website traffic and leads.
benefits: Mass-market reach combined with targeted digital conversion
One creative idea carried consistently across every channel
Media planning and buying focused on value for your budget
End-to-end management of suppliers, production and timelines
Clear post-campaign reporting on reach, response and results
faqs: What is the difference between ATL, BTL and TTL advertising? | ATL (above the line) uses mass media such as TV, radio and outdoor to build awareness. BTL (below the line) targets specific audiences directly, for example through events or direct mail. TTL (through the line) blends both approaches, usually combining mass reach with targeted digital activity.

Is traditional advertising still effective? | Yes, especially for building brand awareness and trust at scale. It is most effective when combined with digital channels that capture and measure the demand it creates, which is exactly what a TTL campaign does.

How do you measure the results of an ATL campaign? | We use reach and frequency data, dedicated URLs and QR codes, promo codes, search and website traffic uplift, call tracking and brand awareness surveys to connect offline activity to real outcomes.

What budget do I need for an ATL or TTL campaign? | Budgets vary widely by market, media and duration. We build a plan around what you want to achieve and what you can invest, and show you the expected reach before any money is committed.

benefits: Custom design built around your brand and business goals
Mobile-first, responsive websites that load fast on any device
SEO-ready structure from the very first line of code
Easy-to-use content management for your team
Ongoing maintenance, security and support after launch
faqs: How long does it take to build a website? | A professional business website typically takes four to eight weeks, while larger e-commerce or custom web projects take eight to sixteen weeks. We agree a clear timeline and milestones before we begin.

Will my website be mobile-friendly and SEO-ready? | Yes. Every site we build is fully responsive and includes technical SEO foundations such as fast load times, clean URLs, meta tags, structured data and an XML sitemap.

Which platform do you build websites on? | We recommend the platform that fits your needs, most often WordPress, Shopify, WooCommerce or a custom React-based build. We explain the trade-offs so you can choose with confidence.

Can I update the website myself after launch? | Yes. We build with an easy-to-use content management system and provide training, so your team can update text, images, products and blog posts without needing a developer.

intro:
A well-built app can open new revenue streams, improve customer loyalty and streamline how your business runs. Eire Tech designs and develops custom mobile and web applications that are fast, secure, intuitive and engineered to scale.

We take your idea from discovery and prototyping through design, development, testing and launch, then keep improving it with real user feedback. You work with one team from the first workshop to the latest release.

Web application development turns complex processes into simple, browser-based tools. benefits: One team for strategy, design, development and launch
Scalable architecture built for long-term growth
User-centred UI/UX that drives adoption and retention
Transparent sprints, demos and progress updates
Reliable post-launch support, updates and monitoring
faqs: Should I build a native or cross-platform app? | Native apps offer the best performance and access to device features, while cross-platform frameworks like React Native and Flutter reach iOS and Android from one codebase at a lower cost. We recommend the right approach based on your features, budget and timeline.

How long does it take to develop an app? | A focused minimum viable product (MVP) often takes eight to twelve weeks. More complex apps with integrations and advanced features take longer and are delivered in phases.
Do you publish the app to the App Store and Google Play? | Yes. We prepare store listings, handle the submission and review process, and make sure your app meets Apple and Google guidelines.

Secure handling of your business and customer data
Seamless integration with the tools you already use
Measurable time and cost savings from day one
Ongoing tuning and improvement as your needs evolve

Video is the most engaging way to tell your brand's story, and audiences now expect it on every platform. Eire Tech produces and edits videos and animations that grab attention in the first seconds and leave viewers with a clear message and a reason to act.

Professional motion graphics, captions and sound design

Creative that aligns with your wider brand and campaigns
